maria: Quick sync 0: need to pick a webinar topic and lock run-of-show. Goal: practical tactics for engineers + concise benchmarks for buyers. 45m presentation + 15m live Q&A.

maria: Three candidate angles: cost-first inference, predictable latency at scale, or open models in regulated apps. Vote now.

tom: +1 cost-first. it's sticky for self-serve leads.

sheila: prefer latency angle for enterprise sales, but cost-first has cleaner demo.

rahul: I can produce a benchmark slide for cost-first that shows tokens/s and cost per 1M tokens across batching configs.

maria: leaning cost-first. speakers: @tom demo + main narrative; @rahul the benchmark; @sheila fallback & SLA callout.

tom: I can run the demo. Need a 10-12min live slot and a short pre-recorded fallback clip in case GPU flake. Will prepare 5 test prompts and a script.

sheila: I'll own fallback patterns, can cover routing & graceful degradation in ~5 minutes.

maria: Rehearsal plan: full dry run 3 days before, micro-run 1 day before. Proposed: Dry run Wed 2026-04-08 16:00 UTC, Micro-run Fri 2026-04-10 18:00 UTC.

rahul: infra checklist I'll prep: model pin, quantized variant, canary rule, metrics hooks, KV cache warm-up.

```
0:00-0:03 Welcome & housekeeping (maria)
0:03-0:12 Why cost-first matters (tom)
0:12-0:22 Live demo: batching & low-cost pipeline (tom)
0:22-0:28 Benchmark: cost vs latency breakdown (rahul)
0:28-0:34 Enterprise fallbacks & SLA patterns (sheila)
0:34-0:40 Customer mini-case (pre-recorded) + key takeaways (maria)
0:40-0:45 Closing CTA & resources (maria)
0:45-1:00 Live Q&A (panel)
```

maria: Action items: (a) tom: confirm demo infra + share 5 test prompts by EOD Tue; (b) rahul: benchmark CSV + chart by Wed noon; (c) sheila: fallback slide by Wed noon; (d) marketing: draft landing page copy + CTAs by Thu.
